steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8085/, sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that literal text exactly). Then find the project 'Bench Board' and open its board. Report the names of the board's columns in left-to-right order exactly as shown, and also whether a task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' already exists anywhere on the board.

02-create: On the 'Bench Board' project board, create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description containing the text '{{runid}}'. Do not move or edit the Seed: tasks. Report the new task's numeric ID as shown on its card (e.g. #12).

03-add: On the Bench Board project, for task {{02-create.new_task_card_id_shown}} '{{runid}} Bench Task': (a) add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}', (b) set its due date to 2026-12-31, and (c) move the task to the 'Work in progress' column of the board. Do all three and verify each on the page afterward; report the comment text, the due date shown, and the column the card is now in. Do not touch the Seed: tasks.
